description: List audience configurations for a Google Analytics property; audiences created before 2020 may not be supported. Returned filter clauses include their types but not the full membership criteria.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing Audiences on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListAudiences call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The property for which to list Audiences. Format: properties/{propertyId} Scoped to a single property per call; invoke separately for each property to list audiences across multiple GA4 properties.
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListAudiencesRequest

name: list_audiences

adsPersonalizationEnabled.description: Output only. Whether this Audience is eligible for ads personalization
adsPersonalizationEnabled.title: Ads Personalization Enabled

createTime.description: Output only. Time when the Audience was created in RFC 3339 format
createTime.title: Create Time

description.description: Required. The description of the Audience
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Required. The display name of the Audience
displayName.title: Display Name

eventTrigger.description: Optional. Specifies an event to log when a user joins the Audience
eventTrigger.title: Event Trigger

exclusionDurationMode.description: Immutable. Specifies how long an exclusion lasts. Values: EXCLUDE_TEMPORARILY, EXCLUDE_PERMANENTLY
exclusionDurationMode.title: Exclusion Duration Mode

filterClauses.description: Immutable. Defines the conditions for a user to be part of the Audience
filterClauses.title: Filter Clauses

membershipDurationDays.description: Immutable. The duration a user should stay in an Audience. Maximum value is 540 days
membershipDurationDays.title: Membership Duration Days

name.description: Output only. The resource name for this Audience resource. Format: properties/{propertyId}/audiences/{audienceId}
name.title: Name

AudienceEventTrigger.description: Schema for event trigger configuration within an audience.

eventName.description: The event name to be logged when the audience state changes
eventName.title: Event Name

logCondition.description: The condition when the event should be logged. Values: AUDIENCE_JOINED, AUDIENCE_MEMBERSHIP_RENEWED
logCondition.title: Log Condition

AudienceEventTrigger.title: AudienceEventTrigger

AudienceFilterClause.description: Schema for filter clauses defining audience membership criteria.
AudienceFilterClause.title: AudienceFilterClause

nextPageToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results. Omitted if no subsequent pages exist
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
